segments.name: Retail sale of food and nonfood products
segments.description: Operates a chain of supermarkets and specialty markets selling food and nonfood products to retail customers in New Jersey, New York, Maryland and Pennsylvania.
segments.evidence: The Company consists of one operating segment, the retail sale of food and nonfood products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for food and nonfood products purchased in its supermarkets and through online ordering, plus service fees, wholesale sales and third-party commissions.
revenueModel.evidence: Other sales consist primarily of sales related to other income streams, including service fees related to digital sales, wholesale sales and gift card, lottery and other third-party commissions.
